mapper.sql: select id, shop_code, currency, rate, effective_date, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time from sdsshop.u_m_exchange_rate
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_exchange_rate (shop_code, currency, rate, effective_date, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time) values (#{shopCode}, #{currency}, #{rate}, #{effectiveDate}, #{remark}, #{createUser}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_m_exchange_rate set currency = #{currency}, rate = #{rate}, effective_date = #{effectiveDate}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from sdsshop.u_m_exchange_rate where shop_code = #{shopCode} and id = #{id}
